data.long_meaning: From the Latin filius, meaning 'son'. The name Filberto is a combination of 'filius' and 'berto', meaning 'bright, shining, new' and 'friend' respectively. In the Middle Ages, this name was popular among nobility and was often given to a firstborn son. The name Filberto carries the meaning “Bright, shining, new, friend” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Filberto usually hope their child will grow to embody bright, shining, new, friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Filberto total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
